fields.label: Bed Charge Basis
fields.description: Per night: one charge for each midnight in the ward (at least one), as Kenyan hospitals bill. Per 24 hours: Marley's default, hours in the bed divided by the unit type's hours.

fields.label: Medicines Item Group
fields.description: Stock items in this group (and its sub-groups) are the medicines the pharmacy dashboard tracks.

fields.label: Pharmacy Warehouse
fields.description: The pharmacy's store, or a group warehouse that holds all pharmacy stores. Blank = every warehouse of the company.

fields.label: Expiry Warning (Days)
fields.description: A medicine with a batch in stock that expires within this many days shows as Expiring.

fields.label: Minimum Days of Cover
fields.description: Stock that lasts fewer days than this at the last 30 days' rate of use shows as Low Cover.

fields.label: Meal Billing
fields.options:
Included in bed charge
Per day
Per meal
fields.description: Per day / Per meal: inpatient bills get a meal line for each diet order's days not billed yet (meals per day x days for Per meal). Nil by mouth days aren't charged.

fields.label: Meal Charge Item
fields.description: Used for diets without their own item. Its price is per day or per meal, as above.

fields.label: Linen Store
fields.description: Clean linen ready to issue.

fields.label: Laundry
fields.description: Soiled linen being washed.

fields.label: Linen Item Group
fields.description: Blank = Linen.

fields.label: FHR Alert Below
fields.description: Baseline fetal heart rate below this raises an alert (WHO: 110; some MOH forms print 120). Above 159 always alerts.

fields.label: Patient SMS
fields.description: Sent through Bulk SMS (RoyceTalk), only to patients who agreed to receive SMS. Placeholders: {{ first_name }}, {{ facility }}, {{ hospital }}, {{ phone }}; reminders also {{ date }} and {{ time }}. Blank uses the default wording.

fields.label: Send Appointment Reminders
fields.description: 2 to 24 hours before, between 7am and 8pm. Turns off Marley's own reminder, which ignores consent.

fields.label: Send "Results Ready" for Lab Tests
fields.description: When a lab test is submitted. Never includes the results.

fields.label: Log Who Opens Patient Records
fields.description: Each time a user opens or prints a patient's record (the patient, encounters, lab tests, admissions, maternity, theatre...), a Patient Record Access entry is written. Required for accountability under the Data Protection Act; keep it on.

fields.label: Require Full Registration Details
fields.description: New patients need gender, date of birth, an ID or passport (a child may have none), a contact number, nationality and residence. Emergency 'unidentified patient' records are exempt.

fields.label: Payment Before Service
fields.description: For cash patients, and for what an insured patient's scheme doesn't cover. Insured patients (for covered items), inpatients and casualty are served first and pay later; a manager can also approve services before payment on a visit.

fields.label: Laboratory
fields.description: A lab test is started only after its request is billed and paid.

fields.label: Radiology
fields.description: An imaging exam is performed only after it is billed and paid.

fields.label: Pharmacy
fields.description: Drugs leave the store only on a paid invoice: take payment on the invoice, or dispense with a Delivery Note once it is paid.

fields.label: Cashiers
fields.description: Who takes patients' payments, and cashier shifts.

fields.label: Only cashiers take payments
fields.description: Patients' payments (Payment Entry, or payment on the invoice) only by users with the Cashier, Accounts Manager or System Manager role. Other service points can bill but not receive money. Insurers' payments and M-Pesa payments confirmed automatically are not affected.

fields.label: Payments need an open cashier shift
fields.description: A cashier opens a Cashier Shift before taking payments; each payment is recorded on the shift, and closing it compares what was received with what was counted.

fields.label: Bill insured visits automatically
fields.description: An insured visit's charges go on its draft invoice as they are ordered, and the invoice is submitted (insurer's share to the claim, signed by KRA) when the visit is closed. A copay stays on the invoice for the cashier.

fields.label: Insured: uncovered items paid first
fields.description: An insured patient is served first only for what the scheme covers (its Item Insurance Eligibility list, approved). Anything else, or anything still waiting for the insurer's approval, is billed to the patient on a bill of its own and paid before the lab, radiology or pharmacy serve it. Load each scheme's list before switching this on.
